    For speakers

    Your session at a glance

    WhenSecond Wednesday13:30 – 15:00 (90 minutes)
    WhereLecture Room B–CZoom is added for hybrid or online sessions
    FormatOnsite, hybrid or onlineSSPO staff attend onsite
    LanguageThai or EnglishEnglish when international guests attend
    MicrophonesUp to 3Tell us how many you need
    Room layoutTheater or classroomAdd extras such as a hard chair or bed

    Steps before and after your session

    1. About three weeks before

      The C&J team emails your team a reminder with the session date, the slot sheet link and the Speaker Consent Form.

    2. Fill in Sheet 2 (For speaker)

      Find the row for your assigned date in Sheet 2 (For speaker) and fill in the details below. Return the signed Speaker Consent Form too.

      • Topic or case name. For an external speaker, add their name, title and affiliation.
      • Presentation platform: onsite, hybrid or online
      • Number of microphones (maximum 3) and room layout
      • Language of the talk
      • Additional requests, such as a hard chair or bed
      • Number of souvenirs for external speakers, if needed
    3. One to two weeks before

      The C&J team orders the session poster, sends the invitation and attendance survey to staff, and opens registration and Zoom for external attendees.

    4. On the day

      Come to Lecture Room B–C a little before 13:30 to load your slides and test the microphones and Zoom.

    5. After the session

      Photos and video are shared with your team to check before anything is posted. The attendance list is submitted for CPD credits.

    Open the speaker sheet ↗

    Inviting an external speaker

    • Send the speaker's details to the C&J team early. The AAIR team issues the official invitation letter.
    • The C&J team handles the speaker's honorarium claim after the session.
    • Ask for a souvenir in the slot sheet if your team would like one presented.
    • Online speakers receive the Zoom link and consent form by email.
